name: Llagostera (Spain)
description: White field with a red vertical stripe through the centre.
history: In July 2014 a vote was held for the people of Llagostera to choose between two flag proposals by Armand de Fluvià, one white with a vertical red stripe at the centre and one white with a red lobster; the stripe won by 46 votes to 41. The flag was approved officially by resolution of the Generalitat of 2 July 2015.
